definitions.explanation: Placed directly after a noun to isolate the thing itself from its circumstances, results, or associated details. Often used to concede that the thing itself is fine while something around it is not.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧{自体|じたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{自体|じたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the work itself, but the commute is hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧{自体|じたい}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: The problem is the high shipping cost rather than the price itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと{自体|じたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}かった→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I don't intend to blame the failure itself, but reporting it late was not good.

notes:
Attaches directly to the preceding noun with no particle: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧{自体|じたい}, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧こと{自体|じたい}. Frequently followed by ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ in concessive sentences of the form "X itself is fine, but…"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧{自体|じたい}: in itself, as such
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧{自体|じたい}: the problem itself
- ⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧{自体|じたい}: its very existence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧: oneself — used mainly with people (⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦{自身|じしん}→自身：30345_jishin⟧, I myself)
- ⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧: the very thing — stronger and more emphatic, and can also mean "the epitome of" (⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧, the picture of health)

NOTE: Do not confuse with the homophones ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧ (situation), ⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧ (declining), and ⟦{字体|じたい}→字体：03337_jitai⟧ (typeface).
